Plot Shapley contributions for a local counterfactual

plot.bl_shapley.Rd

Returns a ggplot2 bar chart showing each variable's Shapley contribution to the path from the observed point to the boundary. Variables are coloured by whether they support or contradict the prediction direction, or have no effect (dark blue, light grey and mid grey). Each variable is labelled "variable: observed -> counterfactual", in original (raw) units when a scaling was set via bl_set_scaling, otherwise in model units. Feature values and the Shapley values on the bars print with the decimals of the comparison tables: 2, or more (up to 4) where a change or a Shapley value would otherwise print as 0.00.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bl_shapley'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A "bl_shapley" object from bl_shapley.

...

Currently ignored.

Value

A ggplot object, returned visibly: it draws when called at the console. Inside a function, a loop or a source()d script, wrap the call in print() to draw it.
